limitations.note: The two-state toggle preserved the faulty two-input cadence instead of allowing three accepted bytes to produce two 12-bit outputs, so the third byte never triggered the second output.
The rewrite changed the first output word to use the second byte’s low nibble, even though the original and correct implementations both use its high nibble.
The passing test encoded the rewrite’s assumptions by expecting the low nibble in the first word and no output on the third accepted byte, rather than checking for the missing second word.

limitations.note: The first simulation command was rejected before it ran because of its cleanup command, so the agent had to submit the test again with different cleanup.
